name: Brow tweezers + scissors
lead: Brow tweezers and small scissors are basic tools for removing stray hairs below and between the brows and trimming overly long ones. Clean brow edges are said to open up the eye area.

The approach is to remove only obvious strays and keep natural shape, since overplucking can be hard to reverse. No specific research exists for brow tools, and the nearest literature is on hair removal methods.

paras: Tweezers grip and pull the hair from the follicle, so regrowth takes a few weeks, while scissors trim hair length without affecting the root.

Common issues are redness, ingrown hairs and folliculitis, and overplucking may thin brows permanently if follicles are damaged. Tools should be clean to prevent infection. The look lasts until the hair regrows.

studies.title: Hair Removal Practices: A Literature Review
